blocks.prompt: 19. Encrypt the word "CLASS" by adding the complex encryption key \(k = -3 + 4i\). Then decrypt it back to the original word.
blocks.explanation: Is baar key zarb nahi balke jama (add) ki jaati hai. Encrypt: \(z + k\). Decrypt: k ko minus karna, yani us ka additive inverse \(-k\) (woh number jo k ke saath jama ho kar 0 de) jama karna. Yeh Sawal 17-18 se aasaan hai, kyunke jama mein sirf real se real aur imaginary se imaginary jorna hota hai.
steps:
Given (diya gaya hai): lafz CLASS, key \(k = -3 + 4i\), A = 1, ..., Z = 26.
To find (maloom karna hai): encrypted numbers, phir wapas lafz.
Method (tareeqa): encrypted \(= z + k\); decrypted \(= (z + k) - k = (z + k) + (3 - 4i)\).

Qadam 1: Letters ko complex numbers banayein
\[C = 3 + 0i, \quad L = 12 + 0i\]
\[A = 1 + 0i, \quad S = 19 + 0i\]
Kyun: C teesra, L barhwan, A pehla, S unneeswan letter hai (S do baar aata hai).

Qadam 2: Encrypt (k jama karein)
\[3 + (-3 + 4i) = 0 + 4i\]
\[12 + (-3 + 4i) = 9 + 4i\]
\[1 + (-3 + 4i) = -2 + 4i\]
\[19 + (-3 + 4i) = 16 + 4i\]
Kyun: real parts aur imaginary parts alag alag jama kiye: real part mein \(-3\) aur imaginary mein \(4i\). Paigham: \(4i,\ 9 + 4i,\ -2 + 4i,\ 16 + 4i,\ 16 + 4i\).
Dhyan dein: \(3 + (-3) = 0\), is liye C ka code sirf \(4i\) hai; real part 0 likhna na bhoolein.

Qadam 3: Decryption key
\[-k = -(-3 + 4i) = 3 - 4i\]
Kyun: \(k + (-k) = 0\), is liye \(-k\) jama karna k jama karne ko ulta kar deta hai. Minus bracket ke dono hisson par lagta hai: \(-(-3) = 3\) aur \(-(4i) = -4i\).

Qadam 4: Decrypt (\(3 - 4i\) jama karein)
\[(0 + 4i) + (3 - 4i) = 3 \Rightarrow C\]
\[(9 + 4i) + (3 - 4i) = 12 \Rightarrow L\]
\[(-2 + 4i) + (3 - 4i) = 1 \Rightarrow A\]
\[(16 + 4i) + (3 - 4i) = 19 \Rightarrow S\]
Kyun: \(4i\) aur \(-4i\) cancel ho jaate hain, aur har letter ki asal value bachti hai. Aakhri S chauthe wale jaisa hi hai.

Tasdeeq (check): \(k + (-k) = (-3 + 4i) + (3 - 4i) = 0\).
Teacher ki baat: dekhiye, ek jaise letters (S, S) ka code bhi ek jaisa aaya, aur har code ka imaginary part \(4i\) hi hai. Is liye jama wali key zarb wali key se kam mehfooz hai: koi bhi pattern pakar sakta hai.
